Name: HIT_MTRL_PARAM_ST
Description: Surface material settings, one row per collision hit material ID. Sets what happens when a character stands on the material: SpEffects, foot effect placement, fall damage, sound reverb, wetness and weather replacement.

Fields.Name: AI Sound Radius Multiplier
Fields.Description: Multiplier on the AI sound radius of noises made on this material. 1: normal. 0: the sound radius becomes 0. A gameplay value, separate from sound effects and particle effects.

Fields.Name: 0: On Hit - SpEffect ID
Fields.Description: SpEffect applied to a character while it stands on this material.

Fields.Name: 1: On Hit - SpEffect ID
Fields.Description: Second SpEffect applied to a character while it stands on this material.

Fields.Name: Foot Effect Height Type
Fields.Description: The height at which to generate the foot effect when hitting this material.

Fields.Name: Foot Effect Direction Type
Fields.Description: The direction in which to generate the foot effect when hitting this material.

Fields.Name: Floor Height Type
Fields.Description: Floor height handling for this material. Used for surfaces such as water, where items float on the surface.

Fields.Name: Disable Fall Damage
Fields.Description: If ON, hitting this material will not cause fall damage.

Fields.Name: Is Hard Material for Sound Reverb
Fields.Description: If ON, this material counts as a hard surface for sound reverb. 0: soft. 1: hard.

Fields.Name: Hardness Type
Fields.Description: The hardness of the material upon impact. Used for soft contact processing of rigid bodies.

Fields.Name: Wet Timing
Fields.Description: Controls whether the whole body gets wet when stepping on the floor material, or whether it gets wet if specified by TAE.

Fields.Name: Wet: SpEffect ID
Fields.Description: The SpEffect ID to apply when this material makes the target wet.

Fields.Name: Hit 0: SpEffect ID (Playthrough 2)
Fields.Description: SpEffect applied while standing on this material in playthrough 2, in place of Hit 0.

Fields.Name: Hit 0: SpEffect ID (Playthrough 3)
Fields.Description: SpEffect applied while standing on this material in playthrough 3, in place of Hit 0.

Fields.Name: Hit 0: SpEffect ID (Playthrough 4)
Fields.Description: SpEffect applied while standing on this material in playthrough 4, in place of Hit 0.

Fields.Name: Hit 0: SpEffect ID (Playthrough 5)
Fields.Description: SpEffect applied while standing on this material in playthrough 5, in place of Hit 0.

Fields.Name: Hit 0: SpEffect ID (Playthrough 6)
Fields.Description: SpEffect applied while standing on this material in playthrough 6, in place of Hit 0.

Fields.Name: Hit 0: SpEffect ID (Playthrough 7)
Fields.Description: SpEffect applied while standing on this material in playthrough 7, in place of Hit 0.

Fields.Name: Hit 0: SpEffect ID (Playthrough 8)
Fields.Description: SpEffect applied while standing on this material in playthrough 8, in place of Hit 0.

Fields.Name: Hit 1: SpEffect ID (Playthrough 2)
Fields.Description: SpEffect applied while standing on this material in playthrough 2, in place of Hit 1.

Fields.Name: Hit 1: SpEffect ID (Playthrough 3)
Fields.Description: SpEffect applied while standing on this material in playthrough 3, in place of Hit 1.

Fields.Name: Hit 1: SpEffect ID (Playthrough 4)
Fields.Description: SpEffect applied while standing on this material in playthrough 4, in place of Hit 1.

Fields.Name: Hit 1: SpEffect ID (Playthrough 5)
Fields.Description: SpEffect applied while standing on this material in playthrough 5, in place of Hit 1.

Fields.Name: Hit 1: SpEffect ID (Playthrough 6)
Fields.Description: SpEffect applied while standing on this material in playthrough 6, in place of Hit 1.

Fields.Name: Hit 1: SpEffect ID (Playthrough 7)
Fields.Description: SpEffect applied while standing on this material in playthrough 7, in place of Hit 1.

Fields.Name: Hit 1: SpEffect ID (Playthrough 8)
Fields.Description: SpEffect applied while standing on this material in playthrough 8, in place of Hit 1.

Fields.Name: Vehicle Speed Rate
Fields.Description: Multiplier on vehicle speed on this material. Vehicle speed = set speed * this rate.

Fields.Name: Hit Material Replacement: Rain
Fields.Description: The hit material ID to use during rain. -1 means no change is made.
